main_body: multi-story campus building with flat roof and four floors of windows
top_band: grey tiled flat roof surface with parapet walls, AC unit, vent, and skylight from rows 1 to 39
evidence: The building clearly shows a deep foreshortened flat roof at the top (rows 1-39) complete with inner parapet shadows, an AC unit, vent, and skylight also drawn in 3/4 view. At row 38-39 there is a bright white front parapet edge, followed by a green trim band (40-41), an eave shadow (42-44), and a detailed 4-story south facade (rows 40-159) with inset windows (dark upper inner frames and light bottom sills) and a protruding 3/4 entrance canopy.

style.evidence: The building uses a rich multi-step grey/blue-grey ramp for the walls and roof, and a multi-step teal/slate ramp for the glass windows with diagonal specular reflections. The wall plaster/brick has continuous subtle speckle texture throughout without flat fills, and all recessed window frames, ledges, and roof details have crisp, well-integrated shading matching the Beodeul standard.
